initial_weights: equal; reset each season and period
update: After all predictions of each date, add log(max(expert_probability_of_observed_class,1e-12)) to that expert cumulative log weight. Normalize using log-sum-exp before following dates. Only intersection rows with all experts are eligible and update weights.
architecture_difference: Sequential supervised model averaging over frozen probability forecasts, not a refit of source expert parameters or a new run-distribution variant. Weights use strictly prior historical development labels only.
tuning: Single frozen design; no weight priors, learning-rate, expert subset or threshold search.
limitations: Experts are correlated; historical development already seen; no calibration or profitability claim. Cannot certify a lineup input or use external outcomes.
